headline: US stock market crash big losers and gainers today: Here
summary: US stocks fell as wholesale inflation came in at 2.9%, above expectations, lowering hopes for near-term Federal Reserve rate cuts. Technology shares declined on AI concerns and oil prices rose.
why: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average are the main benchmarks for US large-cap equities, and Fed rate expectations drive valuations across markets.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Broad US equity sell-off reported on the day of the inflation data.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Wholesale inflation of 2.9% came in above expectations, reducing hopes for near-term Fed rate cuts. Technology stocks also fell on AI disruption and spending concerns, and rising oil prices added pressure.
